EN:
I'm going to make some gestures
and give some clues, so try to guess
what I'm hinting at!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Watch carefully so you can guess
what I'm trying to describe!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Are you ready?

gestos, ¡y tú tienes que adivinar
de qué se trata!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Fíjate bien, a ver si adivinas
lo que trato de describir!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¿Estás list{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}?

qualche indizio. Prova a indovinare
di che si tratta.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Stai attent{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}, non farti distrarre
